extracted.name: Grilled Ham and Cheese
extracted.description: Our easy Grilled Ham and Cheese Sandwich recipe is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner, and made extra delicious accompanied by honey mustard sauce.
ingredient_lines: 8 slices cheddar cheese (, or Swiss, provolone, white cheddar, or your favorite kind.)
instruction_lines: Make honey mustard sauce by combining all ingredients in a bowl and stirring until smooth. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use (can be made in advance).
Optional: Spread a thin layer of honey mustard sauce on the insides of the bread slices.
Layer sandwiches with 3 slices of cheese (or more!) and a slice of ham. Heat a skillet over medium-low heat. Butter the outsides of the sandwich bread.

Cook: Add the sandwich to the hot skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until golden. Flip to the other side and cook for a few more minutes until cheese is melted and bread is golden brown. Serve warm, with honey mustard sauce for dipping.
categories: Best sauce for ham and cheese sandwich
